title: Timber: 48 Tree Felling Styles for Godot 4
shortText: Choppable trees for Godot 4 from your own art: 48 fell styles, both renderers.
html:
Timber is a Godot 4.7 addon that makes the trees on your TileMapLayer choppable: 48 fell styles, every chip, log and stump drawn in code. Royalty free in your games. A free MIT lite with 12 styles is on this page.

Each blow opens a notch in the tree's own bark. The last one brings it down one of 8 ways, from a topple to a burn from the foot up. The crown breaks into clumps of its own leaves, the trunk into logs of its own bark, a stump stays, and later a sapling grows back.

var timber := TimberLayer2D.new()
timber.tile_layer = $Trees
add_child(timber)
timber.chop_at(target, $Player.global_position)

Your trees, as you painted them

Tag your tree tiles with one custom data word (broadleaf, conifer-snap, palm-whip). Timber finds a tree drawn as one big atlas tile, as several tiles painted together, or as a trunk with its canopy on a second layer. The first blow lifts it off the map; regrowth puts the exact cells back.

What is inside

  • 48 styles: 6 kinds x 8 falls. Broadleaf, conifer, palm, dead tree, birch and giant mushroom; topple, crash, snap, whip, uproot, slice, shatter and burn.
  • Signals for your game: a blow, a fall, a landing, and a log spawned where you can give wood.
  • Saves: one small entry per felled tree; a loaded tree comes back as its stump.
  • Stumps that block, side view or top down.

Every number is a slider, from blows to tint.

Both renderers

Every style is checked under Forward+ and Compatibility, the web renderer. Godot 4.7.2; older versions were not run.

Free lite and install

Timber Lite is free (MIT): topple and crash on all 6 kinds, the same nodes and a demo. Copy addons/timber into your project, or open the godot folder and press Play to chop the demo meadow. Read the docs.

Licence

Royalty free in your games, no credit required. No resale or redistribution of the files as a pack.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, the demo trees come from our own generated tilesets, the cover from an AI image model.

More from the same studio

  • Smithereens for Godot 4, breakables that break like their material.
  • Wrack for Godot 4, ruin, burn and overgrow any TileMapLayer.
  • CSAF Godot 4 Sampler, free presets from our addons.
  • Verdant 28 Deep Forest, the demo's oak, pine and birch as a tileset.
